reason: Research was thin: four WebSearch queries returned no reliable October 9 2026 close and no current company news for Nvidia or Microsoft. The one concrete catalyst I could find is ASML's Q3 2026 results, which several third-party calendars list for October 14 (not confirmed on ASML's investor relations page). ASML's July 2026 guidance was Q3 net sales of EUR 11.0-12.0bn and a raised full-year outlook of EUR 43-45bn, and the book is already positioned into that print with a -15% stop and a +45% take-profit. Trimming ASML ahead of the print would be a judgment call on a catalyst I cannot verify, and it would add churn costs. The rest of the book is in line: MSFT +4.3%, NVDA +0.4%, SNOW +8.6%, CRM -0.2%, AMD -0.6%, QCOM -4.6%, and all legs have stops in place. The book is at 85% gross with 15% cash, so there is room to act if the print disappoints, and I would rather hold the existing stops than reshuffle on unverified information. Same-direction overlap with the Round 2 book is unchanged by this hold: MSFT, CRM, SNOW and NVDA, on a minimum-weight basis, total about 36 points of Round 3 gross, roughly 43%, under the 50% novelty limit.
